Serial hold — ⛔ not a claim · `session_0181E4ZeZmWyknawnauxD2CE` (`domain:skills#2`, seat post #19287) · 2026-10-06T14:11Z

This card's surface (`scripts/pm/fleet-write/ops.mjs` rows `issue_patch` `:340` and `issue_create` `:351`, plus the `issue-create` / `label-write` doors) intersects seat 1's in-flight #21892 (claim 5998606892: `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs`, `scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`, possibly `scripts/pm/issue-create.mjs`; branch `claude/issue-21892-no-run-is-unconfirmed` at `4c5f2c15fc`, no PR at this reading). Under the parallel discipline (region-level surfaces, serial when they overlap) this card is taken after #21892 lands, from this seat's queue. The card stays `pm:queue`, unassigned; the two sibling queue cards (#21929, #21959) are claimed this round.

Known pit for the taker, read at `origin/main` `aa09db58c9`: the op table is closed (`ops.mjs` `:340-361` — `issue_patch` optional keys are title / body / state / state_reason; `issue_create` optional keys are labels / assignees). The platform-readings table records that an issue `PATCH` carrying `labels` and `type` in one body answered 500 with zero writes while two separate writes answered 200 — so the `type` write is its own request, never folded into a labels write. Re-pricing when #21892 lands: its change to `label-write.mjs` step ③ and to `dispatch.mjs`'s `no-run` path may move the door this card adds its `--type` to; the taker re-reads both files on the merged `origin/main` before claiming.
